results.overview: Two young russian friends retrace the story of their friendship, giving color to their memories.

results.title: The Craft
results.overview: Sauro Cantafame is “the techie”: he drives solo through a lunar southern landscape in his Ape Car, in a borderland between the real and the absurd. His mission? Implant mechanical hearts in deceased oldsters, so their families can pretend they’re still alive and cash their pension checks. He offers a ride to a fragile kid in danger, whose name says it all, as far as his prospects are concerned: Giocondo Infelice. But that gesture raises the hackles of Vito ‘a scimmia, the crime lord who has full control over the territory. Cantafame teaches the kid his strange trade in death, craft, and discontent; while Giocondo breaks out of his shell and finally finds the father he never had. But Cantafame has a few skeletons in his closet and a negative karma to fulfill, which will goad him to defy Vito in order to save his young charge.

results.title: Vagabond
results.overview: A solitary man traverses landscapes. He travels, contemplates, and dreams. He seems to possess nothing except the backpack that accompanies him and interacts almost without any interaction with other human beings during his journey. Without him seeming to notice, a dog crosses his path at every step. Perhaps it is looking for an owner.

results.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
results.original_title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
results.overview: When ambitious freelance reporter Avery Clark returns to Chicago to spend Christmas with her mom and new stepdad, she's hoping for a little holiday downtime before her next assignment. Instead, she lands a feel-good story profiling Darlene Donnelly, a beloved Chicago Bears superfan about to celebrate an incredible milestone: attending her 500th game. There's just one catch: Avery knows next to nothing about football or Chicago. Enter Darlene's handsome grandson Matt, a Chicago firefighter and die-hard Bears fan who, with a little gentle nudging from Darlene, agrees to show Avery what being a part of Bears Nation is all about.

results.title: Bekel-Bekelan
results.overview: An unexpected incident! A teenager find six "Bekel Balls" left in front of his door. What happens next? No one knows. But don't take it too seriously. Because what happens next isn't important anyway... At least for him.

results.title: The Myth of Sisyphus
results.overview: As the world is ending and people across Los Angeles quietly vanish into blinding light, two teenagers journey to a radio tower to send a final broadcast, while a young man and his grandmother confront what it means to be the last ones left.

results.title: See the Sea
results.overview: As a result of a series of unexpected coincidences, one of the three closet-sitters gets out from his natural environment, but in his absence longing for the friends starts to crystalize…

results.title: Y'a pas de p'tits rôles

results.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Macbeth
results.overview: Two of opera’s most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi’s thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Following past triumphs in many of Verdi’s signature baritone roles, Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite Lise Davidsen—the world’s reigning dramatic soprano—as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske, a brilliant young director making waves around the world. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as the heroic Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Macbeth’s friend-turned-victim Banquo. This live cinema transmission is part of The Met: Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.

results.title: Where Time Lingers

results.title: Silver Bells at Christmas
results.overview: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.

results.title: The Art of Walking

results.title: Lullaby for Empty Rooms
results.overview: Today we are moving out. I don’t think the dead still live here. And our children sleep forever in the rooms where they were born. Come downstairs. Let me hear, for a moment, the echo of my own steps in these empty rooms.

results.title: Cephalopods
results.overview: Set in a distant future within a sprawling metropolis, the animated short film Cefalópodes follows Duda, an insecure beginner drag queen performing in underground bars. The narrative chronicles her tender romantic relationship with Teo, a painter from Saturn's moon, which gradually fades amid heavy silences and emotional misconnections.

results.title: Dating Sucks

results.title: The Return of Captain Kabonga
results.overview: Inspired by the World Wrestling Entertainment, a group of non-professional wrestlers from the Suez Canal city of Ismailia come together to stage performances across Egypt. With limited resources, they are hoping to embark on a journey that will decide the future of their wrestling careers.
